subject: Working with Woven & others
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

We've recently started working with Woven, Wayve, and Oxa - so thought it could be interesting to reach out to explore if we can help at [COMPANY] in a similar way.

The common challenges these teams faced were around existing data visualisation / curation solutions (Voxel51 & internal tools), lacking the speed & scalability required to efficiently visualise their training datasets (struggling beyond ~1m frames).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing / searching through billions of data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters, & natural language searches), enabling AV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with Woven, Wayve, Oxa and similar partners in the space.

Would it be worth us connecting?
